_descriptions.more_realistic: Enables the opt-in AR3-like nonlinear 6-DOF blue model.
_descriptions.blue_inertia: Estimated blue principal inertias [Ixx, Iyy, Izz] in kg*m^2.
_descriptions.blue_wing_area: Estimated blue reference wing area in square meters.
_descriptions.blue_mean_chord: Estimated blue mean aerodynamic chord in meters.
_descriptions.blue_air_density: Constant air density used by the blue aerodynamic model in kg/m^3.
_descriptions.blue_trim_speed: AR3-like blue cruise trim speed in meters per second.
_descriptions.blue_trim_alpha: Estimated blue trim angle of attack in radians.
_descriptions.blue_trim_throttle: Normalized throttle that balances the AR3-like aircraft at trim.
_descriptions.blue_max_power: Maximum blue shaft power in watts.
_descriptions.blue_prop_efficiency: Propulsive efficiency used to convert shaft power to thrust.
_descriptions.blue_prop_min_speed: Minimum speed in the power-to-thrust denominator for safe low-speed thrust.
_descriptions.blue_max_static_thrust: Maximum estimated low-speed propeller thrust in newtons.
_descriptions.blue_dyn_substeps: Internal nonlinear-dynamics integration substeps per environment step.
_descriptions.blue_alpha_stall: Angle-of-attack magnitude in radians where additional stall drag begins.
_descriptions.blue_max_body_speed: Numerical safety limit for each body-velocity component in m/s.
_descriptions.blue_max_body_rate: Numerical safety limit for each body rate in rad/s.
_descriptions.blue_aero_coefficients: blue_CL0 through blue_Cnr are Nuno's derivatives; blue_CLde through blue_Cnda are estimated control derivatives.
